title: Generalized Hamming Weights of AJ-Gorenstein One-Point Codes
summary: We study generalized Hamming weights along the one-point code flag of an AJ-Gorenstein curve. We organize these weights in a graded array, the zero diagram, whose entries are generalized coweights: the largest numbers of evaluation points on which subcodes of prescribed dimensions vanish simultaneously. Twisted and Wei duality show that each row of the zero diagram determines both the generalized Hamming weights of a lower block of short codes and the missing weights of a reflected upper block of long codes in the GHW diagram of the complete flag.
